test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 5 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Lectures A, B, C, D, E and F are to be organised in a span of seven days from Monday to Sunday, only one lecture on each day. One lecture have to be organised only once. One day there will be no lecture. C should be organised immediately before D. E should be before D and there should be gap of two days between E and D. D should be organised before Friday. No lecture should be organised immediately after E. A should be organised on Saturday. F should not be organised on last day.

How many lectures are organised between F and E?
solution:
**Explanation :**

According to the information given, we have:

1) A should be organized on Saturday.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5feb440f01e3e14bf9abb899b2b3db450047d749f27cf7cfcca866de7cde88e9.png] 

 

2) D should be organised before Friday. C should be organised immediately before D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/383a8a852480bdbe97083dc7df9e3d31d7fc4e1a2b34b35c5a821a2379cdbf23.png] 

 

3) E should be before D and there should be gap of two days between E and D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9de14f98cafa72798a25be8b4f11c8a2aa2a914e051883658d59ad9ba99bdb6b.png] 

So, only case 1 is left

4) No lecture should be organised immediately after E. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f08279a9c3a8361444e7fde6bc8c03c754fdeab114beb37f164ad64e0972b4a.png] 

 

5) F should not be organised on last day.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e68530b812f9baa66f661b3b773e316bcd28538398af3a6ed137b16cd020b482.png] 

 

6) One day there will be no lecture. Thus, the final arrangement of lectures will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56374d6bbe7152673c115963b40d03fe1b5e6686a9016acc1d90d1565301720d.png] 

 

**Hence, only 'Two' lectures are organised between F and E.**
